changelog:
- Initial release of "style-design-generator" skill: a style creation engine based on 100 reference style schemes.
- Enables five core operations: swap subject, mix elements across schemes, derive new templates, extend to new styles, and apply styles to domains like comics, novels, and games.
- Utilizes two comprehensive reference files (font design schemes and infographic schemes) with a unified 6-slot template system.
- Provides detailed workflow and mapping methods for each operation, ensuring consistent and flexible style generation across multiple creative fields.
- Includes user instructions, slot mapping strategies, and domain-specific application guides.
